whoItsFor: Developers and teams who want to build, test, and deploy LLM applications such as agentic workflows and RAG pipelines, whether they run Dify Cloud or self-host it.
useCases: Build and test agentic workflows and RAG pipelines on a visual canvas
Integrate and compare hundreds of proprietary and open-source LLMs through one interface
Monitor app logs and performance to improve prompts and datasets in production

requirements.runtime: Docker, Docker Compose v2.24.0 or later
